title: Permission rules (mpi-permission)
description: Gate tool calls with allow / ask / deny rules. Keys are tool names, "*", or "external_directory"; values are one action or an ordered pattern->effect object where the last matching rule wins. Pattern effects accept action strings or { action, message } objects. Messages are emitted only on deny. external_directory also evaluates statically parsed path arguments from common Bash file commands.

action.description: allow: run without approval; ask: prompt for approval; deny: block the call.

message.description: Literal text appended to the winning deny reason and returned by permission_probe. Preserved but not emitted on allow/ask.

anyOf.description: Ordered wildcard rules over the tool's subject (* = any chars, ? = one char, leading ~ or $HOME expands). Last matching rule wins; put "*" first.
